description: This file defines the AlertRecipient class, which is an entity representing the relationship between alerts and their recipients within the OpenMRS notification system. It includes fields for the alert, recipient user, read status, and date changed, along with constructors and accessor methods.

classes.name: AlertRecipient
classes.description: Represents a recipient of an alert, including read status and timestamps, linked to Alert and User objects.

methods.name: getAlert
methods.description: Returns the Alert associated with this recipient.

methods.name: setAlert
methods.description: Sets the Alert for this recipient.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the alert was last changed.

methods.name: isAlertRead
methods.description: Returns whether the alert has been marked as read.

methods.name: getAlertRead
methods.description: Alias for isAlertRead(), returns whether the alert has been read.

methods.name: setAlertRead
methods.description: Sets the read status of the alert.

methods.name: getRecipient
methods.description: Returns the User object representing the recipient.

methods.name: setRecipient
methods.description: Sets the recipient User object and updates recipientId.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, not used for this entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, not used for this entity.
